title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: NOURISH (Nature-Based Opportunities Underpinning Resilient and Sustainable Households) aims to reduce poverty and hunger in vulnerable households and communities in Port Vila, Vanuatu. The project aims to benefit 5,790 women, men, girls and boys through improved sustainable livelihoods, through nutrition sensitive climate smart approaches; increased consumption of nutritious and safe diets; strengthened Disaster Risk Reduction strategies with appropriate climate mitigation and adaptation activities and increased social and cultural empowerment for women and girls. NOURISH targets the poorest households, prioritising those that are female headed, or have a pregnant woman or young child, or are led by a person with a disability. Key activities include Climate Smart Agriculture; savings groups and microfinance; promoting household nutrition; prevention of post-harvest losses; disaster preparedness and management; social accountability around protection of the environment; natural resource management and climate adaptation; addressing harmful attitudes, norms, values and practices around gender equity and social inclusion.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Strengthened Disaster Risk Reduction and management strategies with appropriate climate mitigation and adaptation activities in target communities. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: NOURISH empowers communities to preserve, protect and enhance their natural environment through natural resource managed measures and land management in Port Vila, Vanuatu.The principle aim of this objective is reduce the vulnerability to climate change impacts by increasing the adoption of sustainable management, utilisation and conservation of natural resources in target communities increasing their ability to adapt to, or absorb, climate change stresses, shocks and variability and by helping reduce exposure to them.
